resources.string: Lets InstaTap show its floating controls, find the button you name (for example Accept) and tap it, or tap a point you choose. Screen text is only checked on the phone to find that button. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
1. Turn on the InstaTap accessibility service
Settings opens. Find InstaTap under Installed apps or Downloaded services and turn it on.
Android 13 or newer: if the switch is greyed out, open App info for InstaTap, tap the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Wait for hire: tap the button once when it appears, then stop
Continuous: keep tapping the red target
Button text to tap (exact label, separate several with commas)
Extra delay between taps (ms). 0 = as fast as possible

Press Start on the floating bar. In Wait for hire mode it turns orange and waits; the moment the button appears it is tapped and InstaTap stops. In Continuous mode, first drag the red target onto the spot to tap. Press Volume Down at any time to stop. Drag the bar by its handle to move it.
Set the button text in InstaTap first
